The subject-verb agreement in the sentence "Either the players or the coach have to address the media after the game" is incorrect. When using correlative conjunctions like "either...or," the verb should agree with the subject closest to it. In this case, the closest subject is "the coach," which is singular. Therefore, the verb should be "has" instead of "have."

Corrected sentence: Either the players or the coach has to address the media after the game.
